name: World Cup Soccer Tournament
description: Soc B is hosting a soccer tournament, world cup theme! See below for all rules and details. Sign up as a team (max 15) or individual using the link below, and choose what country you'll represent. Stay tuned for the after party!
details: All games will be played at the MUN Soccer Field outside the Fieldhouse
Games will be two 25-minute halves and a 5-minute half-time
The games will be 9 players and a goalie
You can enter as a team or an individual
If entering a team, a minimum of 3 girls is required
Cleats and shin guards are recommended but not required
No arguing about calls, slide tackling, and offside rules can be decided by teams beforehand
All teams sign up as a country name
Teams must have same colour shirt (based on country colour!)
